description: REVISE a shape you already committed, instead of deleting it and starting over: pass new verts to move the geometry, condition to reassign it to a different finish tag, role to switch between floor_area / deduct / linear, label to name the room it belongs to, or any combination. Quantities are recomputed from the result — a role flip alone re-measures (closed area vs open length). The loop this is for: measure_polygon to commit, view_sheet with overlay:true to LOOK at what landed, then edit_shape to fix the two vertices that overshot into the corridor. label is the per-room reporting seam: this is how a shape traced by hand — or one whose room number the sweep read wrong — joins the same per-room breakdown the Report and the workbook's floor × room tab group by. Shapes a human affirmed (origin.reviewed) are ink and are refused — an agent revises its own pencil and nothing else. Agent self-revision is tallied on origin.agent_edits, kept deliberately separate from the human-correction fields. Coordinates are image px at render scale 2.0: PDF pt × 2, origin top-left, y down (the browser canvas's native space). Sheet payloads carry dims in both px and pt.

condition.description: Reassign to this finish tag (minted on first use)

drop_ft.description: Linear runs only (#441): this run's vertical leg DOWN in feet, overriding the condition's drop_ft default (0 = none). null clears the override so the condition's default applies again

label.description: The room (or phase/area) this shape belongs to, e.g. "134" or "OFFICE 101" — what per-room reporting groups by. Pass "" to clear it

rise_ft.description: Linear runs only (#441): this run's vertical leg UP in feet, overriding the condition's rise_ft default (0 = none). null clears the override so the condition's default applies again. perimeter_lf is recomputed as plan + rise + drop

role.description: Switch what the shape measures — flipping INTO surface_area needs a height on the shape or its condition

shape_id.description: Id returned when the shape was committed

verts.description: Replacement geometry (image px): ≥3 vertices for an area shape, ≥2 points for a linear/surface run, ≥1 for a count marker

name: edit_shape

agent_edits.description: How many times the agent has revised this shape — separate from the human-correction tally

area_sf.description: 0 for linear shapes; LF × height for surface_area; absent for count

changed.description: Which fields this call actually changed

count.description: count shapes only — the marker's EA (preserved across the edit)

label.description: The shape's room/phase label after this call — absent when it carries none (a cleared label reports as absent, not as an empty string)

perimeter_lf.description: Length for linear/surface runs (a linear run's TOTAL incl. rise + drop), perimeter for closed ones; absent for count

plan_lf.description: Linear runs with a vertical leg: the flat trace alone (#441)

vertical_lf.description: Linear runs with a vertical leg: rise + drop (#441)
